//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the FIELDS FAMILY — the data-display label/value system (svelte <Fields>/<Field>/<FieldGroup>, keen fields/1 + field/1 + field_group/1). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY (the pa-fields block). The harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (both dumpers HTML-escape it), so the pa-field items and the pa-field-group title can't flow through the slot — they come from SEPARATE sub-components (<Field>/<FieldGroup>, field/1/field_group/1). So this fixture proves ONLY what the pa-fields container itself emits: its <div>, its pa-fields class, and its RICH modifier set (the valuable coverage here — 23 container modifiers). The pa-field* and pa-field-group* element/modifier classes are accounted for via the `deferred` block (acknowledged out-of-scope prose, because the item/group sub-components feed through the same text-only slot and have no dedicated fragment fixture in this slice). This uses the multi-block form `blocks: [...]` so axis-1's reverse check sees all THREE family blocks (pa-fields / pa-field / pa-field-group) and every one of their modifiers is deliberately accounted for (container modifiers via features, pa-field author modifiers + pa-field-group via deferred, the JS-toggled pa-field--copied via cssStateClasses). Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/data-display.html + _data-display.scss.

propsVocabulary.cols: grid columns 2|3|4 — emits pa-fields--cols-{n}. svelte types it numeric (2|3|4), keen as a string ("2"|"3"|"4"); both interpolate the same class, so scenarios pass the value as a string token that works for both.
propsVocabulary.chips: Notion-style inline pairs with pill/chip values (pa-fields--chips)
propsVocabulary.color: theme colour 1-9 for the left border (pa-fields--color-{n})
propsVocabulary.noBorder: remove the left border (pa-fields--no-border). svelte models this as hasBorder=false (negated); keen as is_no_border=true.
propsVocabulary.body: the container's item area — plain slot text in this container-only slice (the real pa-field children are the deferred sub-slice)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions:
Structural only. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + pa-fields class + modifier set + nesting, not rich item content. Both wrappers emit a bare
{body}
. svelte's hasContainerQuery wrapper (pa-fields-container) is OFF by default and not exercised here (keen has no equivalent prop — it would be an API divergence, absorbed not modelled). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. All 23 pa-fields container modifiers (cols-2/3/4, horizontal, table, bordered, striped, compact, relaxed, inline, row, linear, chips, filled, color-1..9, no-border) are produced here and exercised by scenario goldens. The pa-field item modifiers (--full, --copy-btn/--copy-hover/--copy-click) and value tints (__value--success/warning/danger/info) are AUTHOR-set via the <Field>/field-1 sub-component props (svelte full/copyMode/valueVariant, keen is_full/is_copy_*/value_variant) — real features, but they land on the pa-field block which flows through this container's text-only slot, so they're deferred here (see deferred). pa-field--copied is JS-toggled (cssStateClasses). cols/color use single-template produces that can't carry the {n}, so their produces is null and they are verified via scenarios/goldens; their per-value modifiers are claimed by cssStateClasses so axis-1's reverse check passes.

cols.note: emits pa-fields--cols-{n}; verified via scenarios (produces template can't carry {n}).

color.note: emits pa-fields--color-{n}; verified via scenarios (produces template can't carry {n}).

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; pa-field items are the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: This bucket serves TWO roles here (see loader.json precedent): (a) real JS-runtime state, and (b) claiming block modifiers the reverse check sees but that no single-template `produces` / no in-scope scenario can account for. ROLE (a): pa-field--copied is the JS-runtime copy-feedback class — pa-*.js TOGGLES it for ~1.5s after a clipboard write (snippets/data-display.html COPY PATTERN L357-398 + _data-display.scss `&--copied`); never hand-authored, no feature produces it. ROLE (b): pa-fields--cols-N / --color-N are produced by the cols/color enum features but via a {n} template the expander can't emit (claimed here, exercised by goldens); pa-field--full / --copy-btn / --copy-hover / --copy-click are REAL AUTHOR-set modifiers of the pa-field ITEM block (svelte <Field> full/copyMode, keen field/1 is_full/is_copy_*) — but the item sub-component feeds through this container's text-only slot, so no pa-fields scenario can render them and there is no pa-field fragment fixture in this slice. The blocks list includes pa-field so axis-1's reverse check sees these four; claiming them here (the bucket's reverse-check role) keeps the check honest while their author-feature semantics are documented in `deferred`. They are NOT JS state.
cssStateClasses.pa-field--copied: ROLE (a) — JS-toggled copy-feedback state (~1.5s after clipboard write); never in SSR markup
cssStateClasses.pa-field--full: ROLE (b) — author item modifier (svelte <Field> full, keen field/1 is_full); on the pa-field item, out of this container slice. Claimed here for the block-modifier reverse check; semantics in deferred.
cssStateClasses.pa-field--copy-btn: ROLE (b) — author item copy mode (svelte copyMode='btn', keen is_copy_btn); on the pa-field item, out of this container slice. Claimed here for the reverse check; semantics in deferred.
cssStateClasses.pa-field--copy-hover: ROLE (b) — author item copy mode (svelte copyMode='hover', keen is_copy_hover); on the pa-field item, out of this container slice. Claimed here for the reverse check; semantics in deferred.
cssStateClasses.pa-field--copy-click: ROLE (b) — author item copy mode (svelte copyMode='click', keen is_copy_click); on the pa-field item, out of this container slice. Claimed here for the reverse check; semantics in deferred.

deferred.//: Element/modifier classes of the pa-field ITEM block and the pa-field-group block — NOT pa-fields container markup. In this container-only slice the item/group sub-components (<Field>/<FieldGroup>, field/1/field_group/1) feed through the same text-only slot the dumpers escape, so none can be rendered through a pa-fields scenario. There is no dedicated pa-field / pa-field-group FRAGMENT fixture in this slice, so these are acknowledged PROSE (out of scope), not verified fixture refs. The pa-field author modifiers (--full, --copy-*) and value tints (__value--success/etc.) are REAL wrapper features (svelte full/copyMode/valueVariant on <Field>, keen is_full/is_copy_*/value_variant on field/1) — just owned by the item sub-component, out of this container's scope. pa-field__copy's glyph is the canonical bare span.pa-icon pa-icon--copy inside the copy button (snippets/data-display.html L370-372).
deferred.pa-field: item sub-component (<Field>/field-1) — flows through the container's text-only slot; out of container scope
deferred.pa-field--full: item author modifier — svelte <Field> full, keen field/1 is_full; on the pa-field item, out of container scope
deferred.pa-field--copy-btn: item copy mode — svelte copyMode='btn', keen is_copy_btn; on the pa-field item, out of container scope
deferred.pa-field--copy-hover: item copy mode — svelte copyMode='hover', keen is_copy_hover; on the pa-field item, out of container scope
deferred.pa-field--copy-click: item copy mode — svelte copyMode='click', keen is_copy_click; on the pa-field item, out of container scope
deferred.pa-field__label: item element — the label span inside pa-field
deferred.pa-field__value: item element — the value span inside pa-field
deferred.pa-field__value--success: value tint — svelte valueVariant='success', keen value_variant='success'; on the pa-field item
deferred.pa-field__value--warning: value tint — svelte valueVariant='warning', keen value_variant='warning'; on the pa-field item
deferred.pa-field__value--danger: value tint — svelte valueVariant='danger', keen value_variant='danger'; on the pa-field item
deferred.pa-field__value--info: value tint — svelte valueVariant='info', keen value_variant='info'; on the pa-field item
deferred.pa-field__copy: item element — the copy button (bare span.pa-icon pa-icon--copy glyph); on the pa-field item
deferred.pa-field-group: group sub-component (<FieldGroup>/field_group-1) — titled wrapper around pa-fields; out of container scope
deferred.pa-field-group__title: group element — the <h3> title inside pa-field-group
